author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Official UFC studio headshot, frontal, high-key flash with strong warm/orange grading (cheek samples over-saturated). Two title belts on the shoulders, so probably 2026. Main frontal face reference.

author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Full-body studio cut-out, white UFC shorts with grey/black brush-stroke pattern. Shows the chest piece, BON GAMIN thigh text and both shin pieces. Date unknown (2025-2026).

author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Full-body studio cut-out in the UFC Freedom 250 kit (white shorts, navy star waistband, blue Freedom 250 gloves), so June 2026. Best current physique reference.

author: The White House (Official White House Photo by Molly Riley)
attribution: Official White House Photo by Molly Riley, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Frontal, neutral daylight, rimless glasses, beige suit. Best neutral-colour face reference (skin tone, beard edge, face length). Glasses partly cover the eyes.

author: The White House (official photo)
attribution: Official White House Photo, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: High-resolution three-quarter of his left side, broad smile, sweat, navy/red Freedom 250 walkout shirt. Shows scalp, ear, beard density and cheek line in detail; smile widens the mouth and lifts the cheeks.
